appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Monthly Water Pumping Volume'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 10,000 to 40,000, with major gridlines at 10,000, 20,000, 30,000, and 40,000.
Months are labeled along the x-axis: Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar, May. The order is not chronological.
The bar for May is the shortest, positioned at the bottom of the chart, just above the 10,000 mark.
The bar for Jan is the tallest, reaching 40,000 m3.
The bar for Apr is at 30,000 m3.

printed_facts.fact: The bar for May is visually below the 10,000 m3 gridline.
The bar for Jan reaches the 40,000 m3 gridline.
The bar for Apr reaches the 30,000 m3 gridline.

public_definitions: Review the monthly water pumping dashboard and decide whether May should be handled as a standard low-pumping follow-up or escalated as a critical low-pumping anomaly for this reporting cycle.
Use the dashboard to determine the appropriate low-pumping severity route for May.
May low-pumping route: Route May to standard low-pumping follow-up, Escalate May to critical low-pumping anomaly review, Send May to background monthly record filing.
